points.description: States that terminal 4 is directly connected to / not separated from the negative battery terminal (e.g. no component, resistor or load between terminal 4 and the negative terminal; they are at the same potential/same point in the circuit), so the voltmeter across terminal 4 and the positive terminal reads the full battery voltage (1.5 V). Equivalent wording accepted. A bare statement that the reading equals the battery voltage, without saying terminal 4 is connected to the negative terminal with nothing between, does not earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying terminal 4 is connected to the negative battery terminal with nothing (no component) between them, so the reading is the full battery voltage. No marks for only restating that 1.5 V is the battery voltage, or for unrelated reasons such as a faulty meter.
